items.reasons: The body is a flat front elevation. No shelf plank or top shows as a lit plane from above; the shelves are just stripes across the front. The yellow '-50' sign sits on a thin stem above the outline like a sticker, and the product pixels on the bottom shelf are a noisy mix of red and green specks.

At 1x it is a white-grey smear that does not read as a scale; the weighing pan and display are unreadable. The tall white cylinder at top right sticks out above the body like a detached tube. The cabinet is a front elevation with no top plane, and the brown box on the lower shelf looks like a muddy blob.

The stepped grey rack shows its tiers as lit ledges seen from above, and the short front face has a dark outline that matches the originals. The red, teal, blue and yellow magazine blocks read as magazines at 1x. The footprint sits cleanly on the floor.

It is drawn as a flat front-on wall panel, with only a one-pixel top band instead of a 3/4 top plane. In the room it reads as a low cabinet or display case, not a freestanding partition. The three spotlights hang off thin stems at the top edge and look detached, and the framed art floats in the middle of the face.
